name: Path Replay Backpropagation
definition: An adjoint-based method similar to RB that builds complete differential paths. It finds incident radiance more efficiently using a two-pass approach to solve the quadratic time complexity issue of RB.
summary: Path Replay Backpropagation is an efficient inverse rendering technique that computes gradients by replaying primal Monte Carlo paths, achieving linear time complexity unlike Radiative Backpropagation.
